newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's downgrades IBJ's bond, debt ratings to A2.
newsitem.headline: Moody's downgrades IBJ's bond, debt ratings to A2.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday it has downgraded the Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd's bond and long-term debt ratings to A2 from A1.
Moody's said that the Japanese government's deregulation of financial markets is expected to diminish the volume of IBJ's franchise as a long-term credit bank.

The rating firm said that the advantages of IBJ's main funding vehicle, long-term debentures, will decline over time as Japanese investors are presented with a broader range of long-term fixed-income securities issued by a variety of institutions.
Concurrently, the rating firm confirmed IBJ's C bank financial strength rating and its Prime-1 rating for short-term deposits.
